name: Keo Capital AB (publ)
summary: Keo Capital AB (publ), a fintech company, operates a digital credit platform focused on B2B payments and embedded working capital solutions in Mexico, Brazil, Canada, and Latin America. It operates a unified digital ecosystem that enables buyers and suppliers to interact through complementary solutions designed to improve liquidity, security, transparency, and efficiency in corporate payables and expense management. The company also offers digital B2B payment platforms, such as WorKEO that enable flexible payment terms and optimize working capital cycles, as well as proprietary technology and card issuer services supporting cross-border payments and credit underwriting.
